entries.name: Kneeling Single-Arm High Pulley Row
entries.reason: Own drawn frames on The half-kneeling chain (spine 24.00, neck 9.00, thigh 22.06, shin 22.49 exact) with the drawn high pulley answering how the equipment is used. Full notes and open questions in the daily review.
entries.summary: Five drawn positions of a kneeling single-arm high pulley ro

frames.caption: Half-kneel facing the high cable with the hips and shoulders square.
Reach the working arm long from the square base.
Drive the elbow down and back toward the ribs.
Let the shoulder blade finish the pull at the ribs.
Return to the full reach slowly with the elbow leading.

entries.name: Kneeling High Pulley Row
entries.reason: Redrawn on 9 October 2026 at the owner's request, from the description accepted that day: the earlier drawing did not show both knees down, the rope, or where the pull finishes. Source-bound draft, drawn from a 3D model turned 50 degrees so the elbows going out and the two rope ends show: kneeling tall on both knees facing a pulley well overhead, a rope end in each hand and the arms straight up toward it; the trunk stays upright and still while the elbows go out to the sides and the rope ends come to either side of the upper chest, a brief pause, and a slower return to straight arms. The cable only lengthens on the pull.
entries.summary: Kneeling tall facing a high pulley with a rope end in each hand, pull the rope ends to either side of your upper chest with the elbows out, pause briefly, then let the arms straighten slowly.

frames.caption: Fit a rope to a high pulley, well above your head, and kneel on both knees facing it about half a metre back, holding one rope end in each hand with the palms facing each other and the arms straight, reaching up toward the pulley.
Keeping the torso upright and still, squeeze the shoulder blades together and bend the elbows out to the sides until the rope ends reach either side of your upper chest.
Pause briefly. Kneel tall; do not lean back.
Elbows out, rope to the upper chest.
